components.name: Primary action
components.description: Gold emphasis for the principal explicit action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:4px;font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease;background:var(--primary,#dcc18b);color:var(--primary-foreground,#20251c);border:1px solid transparent;}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--primary,#dcc18b);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#dcc18b);outline-offset:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#dcc18b) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;color:#bec5b5;background:#272b21;border-color:#3f4537;box-shadow:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Explicit action; secondary hover retains a legacy purple edge pending product cleanup.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:4px;font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease;background:var(--secondary,#252a22);color:var(--foreground,#eee9dd);border:1px solid var(--border,#393e34);}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent,#343c2d);border-color:#65517e;}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#dcc18b);outline-offset:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#dcc18b) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;color:#bec5b5;background:#272b21;border-color:#3f4537;box-shadow:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The notebook metaphor comes from the recorded user direction in `docs/technical-learning-ui.md`: ink surroundings, warm paper-colored text, and restrained gold emphasis. The interface supports sustained Korean reading and deliberate learning actions. Paper describes the text's warmth; the implemented surface remains dark.

This is a source-derived record of the implemented system, not a retrospective direction approval. The formal THESIS, OWN-WORLD, STORY, FIRST VIEWPORT, and FORM blocks and concept-seed protocol were not completed. Existing review screenshots precede the final reading-link and bundled-font fixes; final visual review remains pending. Sources: `frontend/src/learning.css` (loaded last), `styles.css`, `typography.css`, `shadcn.css`, `components/ui`, `App.tsx`, `Navigation.tsx`, `Today.tsx`, and `TechnicalReferences.tsx`.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink surfaces with warm readable text and restrained gold actions.
Serif page titles paired with practical sans-serif interface text.
Ruled reading lists, limited prose measure, and generous vertical rhythm.
Three primary destinations with settings in a secondary disclosure.

rules.name: The Bookmark Rule
rules.body: Use gold to identify reading links, action priority, and current position; retain written labels and an underline or other structural cue.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep introductory prose and reading copy within 72ch; longer lesson and reference chapters use a related 74ch limit.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: Keep recurring reading rows transparent with separators; reserve enclosed surfaces for controls, editable material, code, and overlays that need their own boundary.

dos: **Do** use the bundled regular serif for page titles and sans-serif for interface text.
**Do** preserve transparent underlined reading links and distinct explicit action buttons.
**Do** use ruled rows and limited reading measures for primary learning content.
**Do** retain keyboard focus, written states, labeled inputs, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** make primary learning surfaces depend on dashboard tiles or table-centered composition.
**Don't** promote legacy purple literals or every isolated radius into reusable theme decisions.
**Don't** treat pre-fix screenshots or this source record as a completed final visual review.
